compliance.summary: The article’s GoGloby sections and CTAs position the company as a provider of AI implementation squads, rather than a staffing and recruiting agency. They also include unsupported guarantees, credentials, and service claims that need correction.

llm_problems.title: Squads sell implementation services
llm_problems.rule: decisions.md: Company description; Fact Sheet: Identity and Services; Glossary §1 and §2
llm_problems.issue: These passages present GoGloby as supplying squads to build or execute AI solutions, while the sources describe a staffing and recruiting agency that recruits or embeds engineers for clients to direct.
llm_problems.fix: Replace the implementation-squad positioning with the approved company description and the documented recruiting or staffing service model.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby service model
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting Data & AI Engineers

locations.quote: GoGloby fields nearshore squads with senior, FAANG-level engineers
locations.reason: This describes GoGloby as supplying squads to execute the buyer’s AI initiatives, not as staffing engineers for client-directed work.

locations.quote: we don’t just fill roles — we embed FAANG-caliber AI engineering squads
locations.reason: This contrasts recruiting and staffing with squad-based delivery, contrary to the documented service model.

locations.quote: Our squads solve this by delivering production-grade solutions inside your existing stack.
locations.reason: This promises delivery of production solutions, whereas the sources say clients run the engineers’ work.

locations.quote: We embed FAANG-level AI engineers who build production-grade assistants and automations
locations.reason: This offers engineers to build AI products and automations rather than the documented recruiting and staffing services.
